name: @hermes/chrome-bridge
description: Local MCP server for the Hermes Chrome bridge

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.native.json && node scripts/build-extension.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.native.check.json && tsc -p tsconfig.extension.json --noEmit
